abstract: For the $n$-step Syracuse random variable $\mathrm{Syrac}_n = \sum_{m=1}^n 3^{m-1} 2^{-s_m} \pmod{3^n}$ with characteristic function $\chi_n(\xi)$ and primitive mean square $E_n$, we prove four results on its fine-scale Fourier analysis and stopping-shell correlations. First, along the Hull--Dobell orbit $y_t = (4^t - 1)/3 \bmod 3^{n-1}$, an exact Parseval isometry equates $\Delta_{n-1} := 3^{n-1}Q_{n-1} - 3^{n-2}Q_{n-2} = \frac{2}{3} 3^{n-1} E_{n-1}$ to the primitive Fourier energy of $q_{n-1}(t) = \mathbb{P}(\mathrm{Syrac}_{n-1} \equiv y_t)$, giving $3^2 E_2 = 5/7$, Cauchy--Schwarz bounds $E_n/E_{n-1} \ge 7/27$ ($n \ge 3$) and $E_n/E_{n-1} \ge 18581/69905$ ($n \ge 4$), an $O(3^{n-1})$ recurrence $4 r_n(t) - r_n(t+1) = q_{n-1}(t+1)$ on $G_n = \langle 4 \rangle \pmod{3^n}$ with marginal invariance $\widetilde{q}_{n-1}(3^{n-1-r}k) = \widetilde{q}_r(k)$, and the Cyclic Subgroup Spectral Telescoping Law $\Delta_n - \Delta_{n-1} = \delta_{n-1}$ ($3^n E_n = \frac{5}{7}\prod_{r=3}^n (1 + \langle w \rangle_r)$, verified through $n = 14$). Second, for $\tau_j = \min\{m \ge 1 : s_m > j\}$, we show $\tau_j - 1 \sim \mathrm{Binomial}(j, 1/2)$, sharpening [2, Corollary 3] by $62.2\times$--$110.7\times$ ($n \le 1000$) and extending it to $n \le 2394$. In $t_r = j - s_{n-r+1}$, the renewal kernels satisfy a Twisted Pascal PDE, a backward adjoint recurrence, a Cold-Triangle Defect Formula ($d_0 \le 0$), and a Base-$4$ Riesz Product Factorization with Sylow-coset triple-angle renormalization and $\times 2 / \times 3$ digit bounds. Third, $m$-step horizontal unrolling yields a majorant $\widetilde{\eta}_r^{(m)}(s; \xi) \ge |\chi_r(2^{-s}\xi)|$ with $\widehat{Q}_{r,k}^{(m)}(s;\xi) = 2^{-m}\mathcal{P}_k^{(m)}(\theta_{r,s+m})$ ($r \ge k$), $L^2(\mathbb{T})$ saddle rate $1/\sqrt{3} < \log_2(3/2)$, a Binomial Bezout bound, a $(u_i, w_i)$ phase-carry dichotomy, and phase-transition rate $I_{\mathrm{eff}}(\rho)$. Fourth, we prove top-shell cancellation $\Sigma_{\mathrm{diag}}^{(P)}(f) = \mathcal{B}_P(f) - \mathcal{Q}_P^-(f)$ and $\mathcal{Q}_P^-(f) = O(1/m)$. These results do not prove Collatz convergence, deterministic plaquette re-pinning, or an all-$\xi$ exponential bound on $|\chi_n(\xi)|$.
author: cassian_mahler
change_summary: Substantial v2 expansion of collatz_11: (1) Added Theorem 2.3 in Section 2 proving the O(3^{n-1}) first-order cyclic recurrence 4 r_n(t) - r_n(t+1) = q_{n-1}(t+1) and subgroup quadratic identity 5 Q_n - 4\sum_x p_n(x)p_n(2x) = Q_{n-1} on G_n = \langle 4 \rangle \pmod{3^n}, full-spectrum diagonalization 3^n Q_n = \sum_{\omega=0}^{3^{n-1}-1} \frac{15}{17 - 8\cos(2\pi\omega/3^{n-1})}|\widetilde{q}_{n-1}(\omega)|^2 with marginal scale invariance \widetilde{q}_{n-1}(3^{n-1-r}k) = \widetilde{q}_r(k), and the Cyclic Subgroup Spectral Telescoping Law \Delta_n - \Delta_{n-1} = \delta_{n-1} (3^n E_n = \frac{5}{7}\prod_{r=3}^n (1 + \langle w \rangle_r)) with exact Ramanujan-sum mean \overline{w}_{n-1} = -\frac{4^{3^{n-2}}+2}{4^{2\cdot 3^{n-2}}+4^{3^{n-2}}+1}, extending Table 1 from n = 9 to n = 14. (2) Added Theorem 3.3(4) in Section 3 proving the exact 2r-step Base-4 Riesz Product Convolution Factorization P_{2r}^{(k)}(\varphi) = \sum_{c_0+\dots+c_{r-1}=k} \prod_{j=0}^{r-1} P_2^{(c_j)}(\{4^j\varphi\}), the Z/3Z Sylow-coset triple-angle renormalization \prod_{c=0}^2 |P_2^{(1)}(\psi_c)| = \frac{1}{32}|\cos(3\pi\psi_0)| and full \langle 4 \rangle-orbit product \prod_{j=0}^{3^{K-1}-1} |\cos(\pi\{4^j u_0/3^K\})| = 2^{-3^{K-1}}, and short-window contraction bounds from the commutative \times 2 / \times 3 digit grid (leading ternary digit \tau = 1 and binary parity-bit transitions \beta_b = (2^b u_0 \bmod 3^K) \bmod 2). (3) Expanded Theorem 4.2 in Section 4 with the exact single-phase polynomial identity \widehat{Q}_{r,k}^{(m)}(s;\xi) = 2^{-m}\mathcal{P}_k^{(m)}(\theta_{r,s+m}) (r \ge k), the Binomial Bezout exterior bound |\mathcal{P}_k^{(m)}(\theta)| \le \binom{m}{k} - 8\cdot 4^{-(k-1)}\theta^2, the tri-partite (u_i, w_i) phase-carry dichotomy, and m = 48, 60 in Table 4, while incorporating all four minor polish suggestions from the collatz_11/v1 acceptance report.
title: Additive-to-Multiplicative Parseval Isometry, Quarter-Plane Twisted Pascal Green's Functions, and m-Step Horizontal Plaquette Majorants for the Syracuse Characteristic Function
